bounded_work.allocation_note: Multiple full arrays, two materialized direct graphs, four independent CPU token stacks/banks, retained q graphs, clones/hashes and comparison temporaries coexist. Primitive byte counts are not an upper bound for autograd/runtime peak. All work is fixed finite and measured; root selects current availability/minimum free bytes; an OOM is retained failure.

cost_accounting: Synchronized stage allocator peaks and start/end free memory, wall time and cumulative CPU peak RSS cover cache rebuilds, complete reference recurrences, mixed derivatives, all clones/hashes/diagnostics. Cleanup is measured. Success/failure preservation has explicit wall time and whole body includes it. Stage-entry snapshots and reference work are not folded into the B128 resource result. Root external elapsed/exit covers interpreter startup/admission and native termination.
